blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — British actor Robert Pattinson was Monday named as the new James Bond, stepping into the coveted role of the world’s most famous fictional spy. “Amazon MGM Studios have announced that Robert Pattinson will take on the iconic role of James Bond,” the studio said on the official 007.com website. Pattinson would succeed Daniel Craig as the super-suave MI6 agent, “ushering in a new era for one of cinema’s most celebrated characters”, the studios added.
